## Admin Panel for La Bulle

### Phase 1: Database Schema
Create tables:
- **events** — name, type (workshop/networking/masterclass/meetup/conference/webinar), date, start_time, end_time, location, address, description, programme, what_you_learn, cover_image_url, price (free/paid), price_amount, total_places, spots_left, target_audience, difficulty_level, registration_deadline, cta_text, organizer_info, is_recurring, recurrence_info, status (draft/published/cancelled)
- **event_speakers** — event_id, name, photo_url, bio, title/role
- **news** — title, content, cover_image_url, excerpt, published_at, status (draft/published)
- **user_roles** — for admin access control
- Storage bucket for event/news images

### Phase 2: Admin Authentication & Layout
- Admin login page at `/admin`
- Protected admin layout with sidebar navigation
- Role-based access using `user_roles` table

### Phase 3: Admin Pages
- **Events Manager** — Create/edit/delete events with all fields (type, speakers, programme, pricing, spots, etc.)
- **News Manager** — Create/edit/delete news articles with image upload
- Image upload to Supabase Storage

### Phase 4: Public Pages
- **Events listing page** — filterable by type, with spots-left indicators, FOMO triggers
- **Event detail page** — hero + key info bar + description + speakers + programme + CTA + map
- **News/Blog page** — list of published articles

### Key Features
- 🔥 Spots left progress bar (FOMO)
- 🖼️ Cover image uploads
- 👥 Speaker profiles with photos
- 🎯 Event type filtering
- 💰 Price display (free/paid)
- ⏳ Registration deadline countdown
- 📅 Add to calendar button
